verdict.rationale: Supermemory supports batch-friendly ingestion patterns (sending full conversation sessions under a stable customId, connector auto-sync from Drive/Gmail/Notion/OneDrive/GitHub, multi-modal extraction) which enable bulk-like automation, but there is no documented bulk API (e.g. batch add/delete/update endpoints operating on many items in a single call) or bulk search/export operation. missing for 10: explicit bulk create/update/delete API or batch endpoint, evidence of bulk operations at scale, independent confirmation of bulk workflows succeeding.
